name: oraclePaging
sql: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT rownum rn, TB.* FROM ( SELECT a.NTT_ID, b.USER_NM FROM COMTNBBS a LEFT OUTER JOIN COMVNUSERMASTER b ON a.FRST_REGISTER_ID = b.ESNTL_ID WHERE a.BBS_ID = #{bbsId} ORDER BY a.SORT_ORDR DESC ) TB ) WHERE rn BETWEEN #{firstIndex} + 1 AND #{firstIndex} + #{recordCountPerPage}

name: mysqlPaging
sql: SELECT a.NTT_ID FROM COMTNBBS a WHERE a.USE_AT = 'Y' ORDER BY a.SORT_ORDR DESC LIMIT #{recordCountPerPage} OFFSET #{firstIndex}

name: joinSubquery
sql: SELECT a.NTT_ID, c.COMMENT_CO FROM COMTNBBS a LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT NTT_ID, BBS_ID, COUNT(1) AS COMMENT_CO FROM COMTNCOMMENT WHERE USE_AT = 'Y' GROUP BY NTT_ID, BBS_ID) c ON a.NTT_ID = c.NTT_ID

name: commaListAlias
sql: SELECT a.X FROM COMTNBBSMASTER a, COMTNBBSUSE b, COMTCCMMNDETAILCODE WHERE a.BBS_ID = b.BBS_ID

name: asAlias
sql: SELECT T.X FROM COMTNBLOG AS T INNER JOIN COMTNBLOGUSER AS U ON T.BLOG_ID = U.BLOG_ID

name: insertValues
sql: INSERT INTO COMTNBBS (NTT_ID, BBS_ID, NTT_SJ) VALUES (#{nttId}, #{bbsId}, #{nttSj})

name: insertSelect
sql: INSERT INTO COMTSSYSLOGSUMMARY SELECT TO_CHAR(b.OCCRRNC_DE,'YYYYMMDD'), b.SVC_NM FROM COMTNSYSLOG b WHERE b.X = 1

name: selectKeyBody
sql: SELECT NVL(MAX(SORT_ORDR),0)+1 AS NTT_NO FROM COMTNBBS WHERE BBS_ID = #{bbsId}

name: updateWithSubquery
sql: UPDATE COMTNBBS SET NTT_SJ = #{nttSj}, INQIRE_CO = (SELECT MAX(INQIRE_CO) FROM COMTNBBSMASTER) WHERE BBS_ID = #{bbsId} AND NTT_ID = #{nttId}

name: updateAsDelete
sql: UPDATE COMTNBBS SET USE_AT = 'N', LAST_UPDUSR_ID = #{lastUpdusrId} WHERE BBS_ID = #{bbsId}

name: updateFrom
sql: UPDATE T1 SET X = S.X FROM COMTNSRC S WHERE T1.ID = S.ID

name: deleteFrom
sql: DELETE FROM COMTNADBK WHERE (EMPLYR_ID = #{emplyrId}) OR ADBK_ID IN (SELECT ADBK_ID FROM COMTNADBKUSER)

name: deleteNoFrom
sql: DELETE COMTNADBK WHERE ADBK_ID = #{adbkId}

name: merge
sql: MERGE INTO COMTNTARGET T USING COMTNSOURCE S ON (T.ID = S.ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.X = S.X WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (ID, X) VALUES (S.ID, S.X)

name: truncate
sql: TRUNCATE TABLE COMTNTMP

name: onDuplicateKey
sql: INSERT INTO COMTNCNT (ID, CO) VALUES (#{id}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE CO = CO + 1

name: ifBoundary
sql:
SELECT A.X FROM
COMTNBBS A

WHERE 1=1

AND A.Y = #{y}

name: chooseBranches
sql:
SELECT * FROM 
<branch> comthtrsmrcvmntrngloginfo 

<branch> comtczip 

<branch> whitelist_table_required 

 LIMIT 1

name: dynamicTable
sql: SELECT * FROM ${tableName} WHERE X = #{x}

name: dual
sql: SELECT SYSDATE FROM DUAL

name: schemaPrefix
sql: SELECT * FROM COM.COMTNBBS A JOIN "COM"."COMTNCOMMENT" C ON A.ID = C.ID

name: quotedIdentifier
sql: SELECT * FROM `comtnbbs` b WHERE b.X = 'FROM NOT_A_TABLE'

name: commentFrom
sql:
/* FROM GHOST */ SELECT X -- FROM GHOST2
 FROM COMTNREAL

name: tagVerbMismatch
sql: UPDATE COMTNNOTETRNSMIT SET DELETE_AT = 'Y' WHERE NOTE_ID = #{noteId}

name: verbFromTag
sql: WITH X AS (SELECT 1 FROM COMTNCTE) SELECT * FROM X

name: forUpdate
sql: SELECT X FROM COMTNLOCK WHERE ID = #{id} FOR UPDATE

name: insertAll
sql: INSERT ALL INTO COMTNA (X) VALUES (1) INTO COMTNB (X) VALUES (2) SELECT * FROM DUAL
